lines: - Fixed an issue where component testing setup did not offer installed third-party framework definitions, such as `cypress-ct-solid-js` or `@org/cypress-ct-qwik`, when the project's path contained `[`, `]`, `(` or `)`. Fixed in [#35493](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/pull/35493).

- Requests from your application no longer carry Cypress's internal `__cypress.initial` and `__cypress.unload` cookies to your server or to [`cy.intercept()`](https://on.cypress.io/intercept) request handlers. For example, a request with no cookies of its own could arrive with `Cookie: __cypress.unload=true`, and now arrives without a `Cookie` header. Fixed in [#35470](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/pull/35470).

- Fixed an issue where run mode durations of 24 hours or more dropped the whole days, so a run that took exactly 24 hours was reported as `0ms` and a run of 26 hours as `2:00:00`. Fixes [#34976](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/34976).

+- Fixed a regression in [16.3.0](#16-3-0) where privileged commands such as [`cy.task()`](https://on.cypress.io/task) and [`cy.origin()`](https://on.cypress.io/origin) failed with "must only be invoked from the spec file or support file" when the project set a fixed [`port`](https://on.cypress.io/configuration#Global) and `setupNodeEvents` returned a `baseUrl`. Fixed in [#35513](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/pull/35513).
